arg.name: gui
arg.description: Start RViz2 automatically with this launch file.

arg.name: prefix
arg.description: Prefix for robot and its joint names.

arg.name: is_async
arg.description: Whether the hardware component's read/write should run asynchronously.

arg.name: rw_rate
arg.description: Rate (Hz) at which the asynchronous read/write thread runs.

arg.name: scheduling_policy
arg.description: Scheduling policy for the asynchronous read/write thread (e.g. 'synchronized' or 'detached').

arg.name: cpu_affinity
arg.description: CPU affinity for the asynchronous read/write thread.

arg.name: thread_priority
arg.description: Thread priority for the asynchronous read/write thread.

let.name: robot_description_content
let.value: $(command '$(find-exec xacro) $(find-pkg-share ros2_control_demo_example_1)/urdf/rrbot_async.urdf.xacro prefix:=$(var prefix) is_async:=$(var is_async) rw_rate:=$(var rw_rate) scheduling_policy:=$(var scheduling_policy) cpu_affinity:=$(var cpu_affinity) thread_priority:=$(var thread_priority)')
